about: the CSV holds only its header row

reads.note: Read Binary File v1: reads the path into binary data; Spreadsheet File v1 (fromFile, CSV by extension, header row on) turns it into one item per row

expect.offline: No model, no write and no network: the workflow reads one CSV from disk and parses it. The file is written at /data/sample_spreadsheet.csv on both sides; n8n 2.x restricts Read Binary File to N8N_RESTRICT_FILE_ACCESS_TO (default ~/.n8n-files), so the bench must allow /data or the n8n side fails with "access to the file is not allowed" (unverified on 2.47.7)
